messages:
Martha: Quick heads-up — Phoenix Silicon EAP telemetry pilot NDA signed this morning. Link to signed doc: https://redwood.work/drive/phoenix-nda
Ben: Nice, thanks. Did Legal confirm allowed telemetry scope? we should avoid raw prompt text.
Claire: Legal confirmed aggregated perf + counters only. No raw prompts or PII. Full traces only with explicit E2 agreement.
phoenix-pm: (Phoenix) Correct — we only need aggregated counters and kernel-level perf metrics (temperature, power, nvml counters). We'll redact any user strings.
Samar: Ops question: can we run their patch on our CI runner? we'll need the bench harness + model configs.
Ben: Prefer to start with a tight window: 4 models, 3 warmup runs, 5 measurement runs. Please confirm sequence lengths.
Samar: Proposed set: chat-7b (seq 1024), chat-13b (seq 1024), mistral-like-8b (seq 2048 quantized), llama-70b-qat (seq 512). Agree?
phoenix-eng: Agree on the list. We'll provide kernel optimizations and recommended flags. Expect slightly different throughput numbers.
Claire: Ops/legal constraint — telemetry must be scrubbed of prompt/user tokens. Add `user_id` hashing and remove token content before export.
Ryan: I'll add a telemetry opt-in flag to the runner: `--telemetry=phoenix_eap --scrub=true`.
Ryan: Example run:
```
./run_bench --model=mistral-8b --seq=2048 --telemetry=phoenix_eap --scrub=true --runs=5
```
ops-bot: deploy queued for canary infra (canary-2) at 03:00 UTC :rocket:
Ben: We'll collect p50/p90/p99 latencies, tokens/sec, and memory high-water. Baseline numbers will be our current stable commit.
Claire: Who owns the feedback loop to Phoenix? I can coordinate post-run triage, but need parsing helpers.
phoenix-pm: We'll send parsing scripts + schema v1.1 after the run. Also can set up a quick debrief call Thu.
Martha: Checklist: NDA ✅, models pinned ✅, runner flag added ✅, bench window Tue-Wed. Ben to open dashboard PR for perf dashboards.
Ben: I'll add Grafana panels and an alert for >10% degradation on p99 :thumbsup:
Claire: Legal: retention policy 30 days for raw telemetry, then auto-delete. Confirmed — add to README.
Martha: I'll update the shared drive and send calendar invite for the debrief. Thanks everyone.
phoenix-eng: Thanks — we'll drop sample payloads in the S3 bucket by EOD.
Martha: End of thread — continuing in the bench PR if anything pops up.
